name: @shrubbery/rhizome
description: RHIZOME — the read-only memory observatory. Renders a gardend cell's :projection:memory named graph (subject-beds, lineage, supersession, the ?asof temporal lens) as curl-able resources via @shrubbery/render's mem-plot / mem-subject faces. App/tooling level — the SPARQL /mcp wire + the cell reads live here, behind the pure render package.
